zh_CN: 关于 API 钱包的疑问，在这里找到答案。
en_US: Answers to common questions about API Wallet.
How do I get an API key?

zh_CN: 在对应平台的控制台 → API Keys 页面创建即可：
en_US: Create one in each platform's console, under the API Keys page:

zh_CN: DeepSeek：platform.deepseek.com；OpenAI：platform.openai.com；Anthropic Claude：console.anthropic.com；Kimi：platform.moonshot.cn；智谱：bigmodel.cn。拿到 Key 后，在 API 钱包中选择对应服务商，粘贴保存即可查询。
en_US: DeepSeek: platform.deepseek.com; OpenAI: platform.openai.com; Anthropic Claude: console.anthropic.com; Kimi: platform.moonshot.cn; Zhipu: bigmodel.cn. Then pick the provider in API Wallet, paste your key and save.

zh_CN: 我的 API Key 安全吗？
安全。API Key 使用 iOS Keychain 加密存储，仅保存在你的设备上。App 不会将任何 Key 或余额数据上传到本 App 之外的任何服务器，所有查询请求由你的设备直接发送至各平台的官方 API。
en_US: Yes. Keys are encrypted in the iOS Keychain and stay on your device. The app uploads no keys or balance data to any server of ours — every request goes straight from your device to each platform's official API.

zh_CN: 删除某个配置时，Keychain 中对应的 Key 会同步删除。
en_US: Deleting a configuration also deletes its key from the Keychain.
How do I add the home-screen widget?

zh_CN: 在主屏幕长按空白处 → 点击左上角「+」→ 搜索「API 钱包」→ 选择尺寸添加。添加后长按小组件 →「编辑小组件」，即可勾选希望展示的服务商。
en_US: Long-press the home screen → tap “+” → search for “API Wallet” → pick a size. Then long-press the widget → “Edit Widget” to choose which providers appear.

zh_CN: 注意：请先在 App 内完成一次余额查询，小组件才会有数据显示。小组件约每 30 分钟由系统自动刷新。
en_US: Note: run one balance query in the app first so the widget has data to show. The system refreshes widgets roughly every 30 minutes.

zh_CN: 同一服务商可以添加多个 Key 吗？
en_US: Can I add multiple keys for one provider?

zh_CN: 可以。同一服务商可重复添加多个 Key（例如主账号与公司账号），通过备注区分，卡片上会显示在名称旁。
en_US: Yes. Add as many keys per provider as you like — a personal and a company account, for example — and tell them apart with notes shown next to the name.

zh_CN: 打开 App 或下拉刷新时会立即查询全部服务商；也可以在每个服务商的编辑页设置自动查询间隔（仅在 App 前台运行时生效）。
en_US: Opening the app or pulling to refresh queries every provider instantly. You can also set a per-provider auto-refresh interval (active while the app is in the foreground).

zh_CN: 如何查询自定义 / 中转服务的余额？
en_US: Can I query custom or relay endpoints?

zh_CN: 在主页「+」菜单中选择「自定义 API」，填入请求地址与（可选的）API Key，并编写查询脚本。脚本支持变量替换，保存前可使用「测试查询」验证配置是否正确。
en_US: Choose “Custom API” from the “+” menu on the home screen, enter the base URL and an optional API key, then write a query script. Variable substitution is supported, and “Test Query” verifies everything before you save.
How do I delete my data?

zh_CN: 删除某个服务商配置时，App 会同步删除 Keychain 中保存的 API Key。卸载 App 即清除全部本地数据，不会留下任何痕迹。
en_US: Deleting a provider configuration removes its key from the Keychain. Uninstalling the app wipes all local data — nothing is left behind.
